business_rules: A user can only access messages from channels where the user is a member.
Deleted messages must use soft delete.
The authenticated user identifier must come from the access token.
The AI copilot can only retrieve messages visible to the authenticated user.
Private channel messages must never be exposed to non-members.
Message history must use keyset pagination.
Passwords must never be stored in plain text.
